profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Capital One
profile.summary: I'm a software engineer skilled in developing, creating, debugging, and maintaining large, robust, and scalable web applications. I have extensive industry experience with front-end tooling such as Angular, React, and standard HTML, CSS (and preprocessors), and TypeScript. I also have expertise in backend tooling and languages such as Java and Spring, Kafka, Kotlin, Rust, Express.js, PostgreSQL, and Prisma. I have a love for technology and a passion for fixing things, and as a software engineer, I get to do both.
